profile.description:
Specializes in building workflows that combine bots on Poe. Powered by Claude Code. Guide and tips: https://creator.poe.com/docs/script-bots/quick-start

Note: Script-Bot-Creator cannot access messages sent to or from other bots.

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.

rate_cards.rateMenuMarkdown: Script-Bot-Creator may make multiple calls to [Claude-Sonnet-4.5](https://poe.com/Claude-Sonnet-4.5), [Claude-Haiku-4.5](https://poe.com/Claude-Haiku-4.5) or [Claude-Opus-4.6](https://poe.com/Claude-Opus-4.6). Each call is charged at the respective bots' rates.
